description: The two barber clauses have one generalized inference selecting both complete fresh parents, using exactly the substitution sending \(x_0,x_1\) to \(a\) and fixing all other variables as a most general unifier, with empty conclusion.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.barber_step.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (B : L.Relations 2)
  (a : L.Functions 0) :
  ∃ d,
    d.positiveFamily =
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.leftCopy (Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.barberC B a) ∧
      d.negativeFamily =
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.rightCopy
            (Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.barberD B a) ∧
        d.unifier = Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.barberMu a ∧
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.resolvent d = ∅
